scenicChapters.title: Valdez → Thompson Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 73 km. 855 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Richardson Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 855 m come off over 7 km at around 22.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

richardson-highway.story: A one-way ride of 778 km, Valdez to the finish - roughly 10 h 33 in the saddle. It goes by way of Thompson Pass, Worthington Glacier and Glennallen. The highest point is about 1,200 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: For 18 km this is Trollstigen, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 17 km. 848 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 39 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Geiranger-Trollstigen Norwegian Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 26.1%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Trollstigen
scenicChapters.narrative: 848 m come off over 17 km at around 5.5%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

norway-trollstigen-and-geiranger-switchb.story: 418 km from Åndalsnes to Åndalsnes, about 8 h 20 of riding. The stops in between: Valldal strawberry stop, Eagle Road and Geiranger fjord. The climb of the day is Trollstigen. It tops out at about 1,150 m. Trollstigen is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.
